description: CORE brewing outputs from native Idleon 1.24 cauldron functions. Stored progress uses the retained save, not runtime balances. Best-brewer and saved-attempt projections have separate independently sourced result entries.

extractions.label: brew_requirements
extractions.description: Native brew points required per attempt for Power, Quicc, High-IQ, and Kazam cauldrons.

extractions.label: brew_speeds
extractions.description: Total brew points per hour from all assigned characters. The retained account has no assigned brewer, so every total is zero. An individual character's brew speed is not the cauldron's total.

extractions.label: actor_new_bubble_chances
extractions.description: Unclamped native percent chance for the explicit acting player. This is not the best-account Bubble Breakthrough preview.

extractions.label: boost_requirements
extractions.description: Brew points required for Speed, Luck, Cost, and Extra boosts in each brewing cauldron. The game still returns a numeric requirement for maxed boosts.
